jobs.description:
Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

Responsibilities

• Define and promote front-end development standards, architecture guidelines, and reusable frameworks across the organization.
• Provide technical leadership and architectural governance to multiple delivery teams to ensure solution consistency.
• Manage the technology lifecycle and drive initiatives to reduce technical debt and upgrade core platforms.
• Translate complex business and functional requirements into sustainable technical architectures and documentation.
• Lead the adoption of emerging technologies, specifically focusing on Artificial Intelligence and innovation within development practices.
• Conduct technology evaluations, impact assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise-grade web applications.
• Coach and mentor developers to enhance the team’s technical skills and foster a community of practice.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience as a Technical Architect or Solution Architect within a complex enterprise environment.
• 3+ years of expert-level knowledge in Angular and modern front-end development practices.
• 3+ years of experience with .NET and .NET Core ecosystems.
• 3+ years of experience in Web Security standards and secure development practices.
• 3+ years of experience with Authentication and Authorization standards including OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
• You possess a strong background in designing enterprise-grade web applications with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
• You bring the ability to produce high-quality architecture documentation and technical implementation guidelines.
• You're an experienced technical leader with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset and strong analytical capabilities.
• You have excellent communication skills and the ability to present technical decisions to governance boards.
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French, with at least basic knowledge of the other.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot or GenAI solutions.
• Knowledge of Design Systems and UI component libraries.
• Previous experience in the insurance or financial services sector.
• Experience working within an Architecture Board or similar corporate governance body.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager CAPEX Process Industry
jobs.description:
Project overview

As CAPEX Project Manager, you drive large multidisciplinary investment projects within the process industry. You take full responsibility for scope, budget, schedule, quality and safety, covering both greenfield developments and substantial revamps or modifications of existing industrial facilities.

Primary tasks & responsibilities

• Lead industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept definition through engineering, execution, commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Steer all project phases, including pre-studies, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site activities, commissioning and operational transfer.
• Act as the central point of accountability for stakeholders and management across the entire project lifecycle.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines, working with both internal and external parties.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims and deviations affecting budget, planning or delivery.
• Report in a structured way on progress, issues and key decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also have at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in fields such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You bring solid expertise in pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Background in the process industry is essential.
• You have strong hands-on knowledge of MS Project and personally own project planning rather than only tracking it.
• You combine an academic mindset with strong analytical skills and a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You show strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when required.
• You communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders at every level of the organisation.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

Responsibilities

• Design and drive a comprehensive change plan using structured methodologies such as ADKAR.
• Create conditions for successful adoption by anticipating resistance and supporting impacted teams during the transition.
• Plan and coordinate change activities to ensure internal and external stakeholders are prepared for new ways of working.
• Collaborate with core project teams to align communication strategies and project priorities.
• Monitor progress and identify potential risks to provide clear status reporting.
• Facilitate workshops and co-creation sessions linked to process improvement and transformation.

Requirements

• You have proven experience in change management for large-scale digital transformations.
• You possess deep knowledge of the ADKAR methodology and its practical application.
• You're experienced in stakeholder management and engaging with diverse teams at all organizational levels.
• You bring a structured and proactive approach to planning and following up on change activities.
• You have strong skills in facilitating workshops and brainstorming sessions.
• You are fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Previous experience within the telecommunications industry.
• Willingness to visit local sites to collect feedback and build trust with teams.

Are you the Incident Manager we’re looking for?

We are looking for an experienced Incident / Problem Manager to join an Application Support team based in Brussels.

You will play a key role in managing application-related incidents and problems, with a strong focus on reducing recurring incidents, improving service stability, and driving continuous improvement.

You will join a small, collaborative team and work closely with technical and application support teams to ensure incidents are effectively managed, root causes are identified, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
Role
• Manage the end-to-end Incident Management process for application-related incidents.
• Lead and coordinate the Problem Management process, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
• Monitor and follow up on application-related incidents, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and resolution.
• Identify trends and recurring incidents and implement actions to reduce incident volumes.
• Support the management of incidents across different priority levels, including P3–P4.
• Monitor application environments using Datadog.
• Work with ServiceNow for incident and problem management.
• Analyse incident trends and identify opportunities for service improvement.
• Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and technical teams to resolve complex issues.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of application support and IT service management processes.
• Participate in an on-call rotation, currently expected to be approximately one week in three. Out-of-hours incident volumes are currently low.
Profile
We are looking for someone with a backgound Incident Management, Problem Management, or Application Support experience.

You should have:

• Proven experience in Incident Management and/or Problem Management or Support engineering. .
• Previous experience within an Application Support environment.
• Experience working with ServiceNow.
• Experience with Datadog or a similar monitoring solution.
• Good working knowledge of SQL.
• A hands-on approach and the ability to work closely with technical teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• The ability to work effectively in a small, collaborative team.
• Fluent/professional English.

Join a stable and international environment where you can keep learning, take ownership and enjoy a healthy work-life balance.

They are looking for aSystem & Network Engineerto strengthen their infrastructure team and contribute to the reliability, security and continuous improvement of their IT environment.

What makes this opportunity stand out?You get to work on interesting infrastructure and networking challenges, while being part of a company that genuinely values work-life balance.

Executive Driver, NATO Headquarters

Application deadline: 12 October, 11:59 PM CET

Apply here: https://bit.ly/3TJGHQq 

 

• ABOUT THE ROLE
Do you have experience as a professional VIP driver? 

NATO's Office of Security is hiring! 

The Executive Driver will plan and execute the transportation of NATO senior leaders - primarily in Brussels, Belgium but also occasionally in neighbouring cities and countries. They will drive armoured and non-armoured passenger cars and vans, on official NATO business, following protocol and adhering to organizational priorities. 

They will also be responsible for handling various administrative and maintenance actions linked to the daily tasks. 

Please note that this position requires flexibility to work outside normal working hours at short notice and be assigned on-call duties, when required.
 
2. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

The incumbent must:

¿ have an educational background, equivalent to higher secondary level;

¿ have 3 years of experience as a professional VIP driver working for organisations with high-ranking civilians/military commanders or high-level governmental institutions;

¿ hold a driving license for B (normal vehicles) and C (vehicles >3.5 T) categories, according to Belgian regulations;

¿  possess a valid medical certificate, or willingness to review it, allowing the driving of heavy transport; and

¿ possess the following minimum levels of NATO's official languages (English/French): V (¿Advanced¿) in one; III (¿Intermediate¿) in the other.

The following would be considered an advantage:

¿ knowledge of and certification in advanced driving skills and a first-aid/BLS-AED certificate provided by a recognized school or institution; 

¿ experienced knowledge of road infrastructure in Brussels, Belgium and surrounding countries; and

¿ been an active member of a Close Protection Team of a NATO member nation's security or intelligence service, armed forces or of their civilian/military police.

As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area. 

Your missions:
 
Customer & internal technical support
  
• Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors. 
• Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions 
• Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors. 
• Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team. 
• Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team. 
• Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.  
Continuous improvement & documentation
  
• Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement. 
• Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product). 
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. 
• Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams. 
• Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.  
Team
 
You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.
 
Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education: 
 
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function 
• Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions 
• Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides 
• Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)  
Your soft skills and personal qualities:
  
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers 
• Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation 
• Method, rigor and stress management 
• Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback 
• Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)

To strengthen its Compliance team in Antwerp, the organization is currently looking for a Compliance Officer who will support the Head of Compliance and AMLCO across a broad range of regulatory and financial crime compliance responsibilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the Compliance Manager in the execution and monitoring of the annual compliance plan
• Contribute to the review and implementation of AML/KYC policies, procedures and transaction monitoring processes
• Ensure timely and accurate preparation of regulatory reporting and returns
• Perform ongoing transaction monitoring and escalate relevant alerts and findings to the AMLCO

• Good understanding of AML/KYC, Customer Due Diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions and embargoes

• A financial crime or compliance certification is considered an asset

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different stakeholders
• Pragmatic, proactive and solution-oriented mindset
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
• Very good command of English is required, Dutch is a plus

Our client is an established international professional services organization.

Jobomschrijving

• Map and document end-to-end processes across the different Business Services functions.
• Meet with key stakeholders to understand how processes are currently performed in practice.
• Document current-state ("as-is") processes, including responsibilities, systems, approvals and dependencies.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities to create clearer and more efficient ways of working.
• Develop practical future-state ("to-be") processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Create clear process documentation using tools such as Visio or PowerPoint.
• Ensure critical operational knowledge is properly captured and documented.
• Review and centralize existing supplier contracts, including ownership, expiry dates, renewal periods and key obligations.
• Review insurance arrangements and help identify potential gaps, overlaps or inconsistencies.
• Establish a practical approach for monitoring contract renewals, expiry dates and related actions.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to ensure the appropriate contracts and governance are in place.
• Review and improve processes related to signing rights and delegated authorities.
• Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and ensure the work progresses independently with limited day-to-day supervision.

• Demonstrated experience as a Business Process Consultant, Process Improvement Consultant, Business Operations Consultant or process-oriented Business Analyst.
• Strong hands-on experience with business process mapping and documentation.
• Able to conduct stakeholder interviews and translate complex information into clear and practical processes.
• Experience creating as-is/to-be process maps and SOPs.
• Previous exposure to contract management, supplier governance or operational governance is highly valuable.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Autonomous and execution-focused: you are comfortable taking ownership and delivering the work from start to finish.
• Pragmatic and hands-on profile rather than purely strategic or advisory.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong advantage.

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager - Supply Chain & Logistics - Belgium
jobs.description:
Our client is a market-leading European provider of logistics, transportation, and supply chain solutions, serving major international brands across the consumer goods and retail sectors. With a strong presence in Belgium and an extensive European network, the company operates in a fast-paced and operationally complex environment where service quality, customer partnership, and continuous improvement are key drivers of success.With a strong footprint in Belgium and a broader European presence, the organisation is currently going through an important phase of growth. This creates a stimulating environment where commercial teams work closely with operational stakeholders to deliver long-term value for customers and drive continuous improvement across the business.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of major international accounts. Your primary focus will be to strengthen long-term client partnerships, ensure customer satisfaction, and identify opportunities for sustainable business growth.

Key responsibilities include:

• Acting as the main point of contact for strategic customers across Belgium and Europe.
• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders within client organisations.
• Proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
• Leading contract renewals, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, and volume agreements.
• Managing customer escalations and coordinating effective solutions with internal stakeholders.
• Working closely with operational teams to ensure service excellence and continuous improvement.
• Monitoring account performance, profitability, and commercial KPIs.
• Coordinating with multiple internal departments and business sites across Belgium.
• Contributing to business development initiatives within existing accounts and identifying selected growth opportunities.
• Frequent travel across Belgium, with occasional travel within Europe.

• At least 5 years of experience in a strategic B2B Key Account Management position.
• Proven experience managing large and complex customer accounts.
• Strong negotiation skills with exposure to senior decision-makers.
• Solid understanding of logistics, transportation, supply chain, or another operationally B2B environment.
• Ability to navigate complex organisations and manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
• Highly autonomous, proactive, and capable of taking ownership.
• Strong commercial mindset combined with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Solution-oriented with the resilience to manage challenging situations and customer escalations.
• Analytical, structured, and eager to learn.
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Willingness to travel regularly across Belgium and occasionally within Europe.

The company emphasizes a personal approach, coaching, and growth opportunities, with decisions made locally to adapt to market needs.

• Manage and grow existing accounts (approx. 65% farming) and acquire new customers (approx. 35% hunting) by building, developing and maintaining strong & long-term relationships with dental professionals and stakeholders
• Drive sales of dental implants, prosthetic, and digital solutions in East Flanders & Antwerp, focusing on hospitals, dental practices, and dental labs.
• Understand customer needs and provide complete solutions, from patient acceptance and diagnostic data capture to surgery and final prosthetic delivery.
• Educate dental professionals on the benefits, the utilization and the clinical aspects of products and digital workflows.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure high-quality services and products delivery

• Previous experiences or strong interest in dental products
• Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
• You are structured and proactive, you achieved KPI & are accurate with CRM update
• Your are autonomous, disciplined, and results-oriented, with a collaborative team spirit.
• Dutch Native & Fluent in English .

Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.

This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Jobomschrijving

Application & Service Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
• Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
• Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
